Business Plan:

Joshua Rose Enterprises is an online clothing store that specializes in sustainable and ethically sourced fashion. The business was started in 2018 and has seen consistent growth since its inception. The loan will be used to expand the product line and increase marketing efforts to reach a wider audience. The company has a proven track record of financial responsibility and a strong online presence. With the requested loan, Joshua Rose Enterprises plans to increase revenue by 30% in the next fiscal year.

Additional Information:

Joshua Rose has a bachelor's degree in business administration and has 10 years of experience in the retail industry. The company currently has 5 employees and operates primarily online, with a small warehouse for storage and shipping. Joshua Rose Enterprises is committed to reducing its carbon footprint and donates a portion of its profits to environmental conservation efforts.
